blocks.title: 🏛️ Canonical Reference & Masterfile Integration
blocks.text: This flagship scheme is comprehensively detailed in the Government Schemes Masterfile (Section: "migrated-schemes-masterfile"). Key highlights and parameters are summarized below.

items: Ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Objective: Improve nutrition for children under 6, pregnant women, and lactating mothers
Poshan 2.0: Includes Anganwadi Seva Yojana and Scheme for Adolescent Girls (14-18 years)
Monitoring: Real-time tracking through digital platforms
Annual Celebration: National Nutrition Month in September
